title: Chapter 391
text:
Han Xiao also liked to watch Pork Bun's videos as a form of relaxation.

At the beginning of every episode, Pork Bun would do a pre-episode recap and make it into a series. The third episode continued the previous episode, and this time, the background shown in front of the players was even grander. It was an intergalactic battle, and the galaxy was vast and grotesque, allowing the players to understand more details of life in the galaxy. More and more forces appeared, such as the Silvers from other Star Fields, Sky Ring, and the other super large mercenary groups, Floating Dragon Island, and so on.

The perspective of the video was Pork Bun's third party, starting from the moment he accepted the Silvers' employment. The scene changed to when he arrived at Floating Dragon Island. The colors were psychedelic, and the environment was dangerous. The huge mercenary group rampaged across Floating Dragon Island, with all kinds of races and equipment. The players were among them, and the audience felt like they were participating in the game.

"Sigh, I'm so envious of these gods. They can wander around in the universe."

"The pro players are strong after all. Have you forgotten what happened in the past? Those who can last more than thirty seconds against Black Phantom are all real men."

"Hehe, only our gods are up in the sky. I heard that the clubs from other countries are under a lot of pressure and have to work overtime every day to complete missions."

All the clubs were preparing for the National League in nine months. The professional players who followed Han Xiao had the best opportunity to develop, which put a lot of pressure on the other participants.

Pork Bun's editing was very decisive, and he jumped to the next event very quickly. The mercenary group had locked onto their target, and the battle at the dock was about to break out. Hundreds and thousands of people were fighting, and all kinds of abilities were unleashed. Colorful lights flashed, explosions, roars of beasts, lightning, and other background noises shook the eardrums. There were pirate groups shooting at the same time, and lasers sweeping across. There were Pugilists clashing with each other, and sparks flew everywhere.

The audience was dazzled. They felt as if they were really on the battlefield. They were like a small boat that had been overturned by the waves. Following Pork Bun's perspective, they followed behind Han Xiao with an irresistible force.

From the perspective of the screen, they could clearly see Han Xiao's battle. He was wearing a sturdy and complicated black mechanical suit. A pair of mechanical turbine bat wings spread out from his back. His scythe had electric arcs, and he looked like the God of Death. Then, heavy armor components fell from the sky. The components automatically covered his body through magnetic connections. In the blink of an eye, he transformed into a four-meter-tall exoskeleton mechanical giant. He took large strides, and his fists were like iron balls. He dug out a path to the sky, and no one could stop him.

"You look so handsome in this metal suit. Can you transform and set off?"

"Ah, these sharp lines, this precise and complex structure, this is the beauty of machinery!"

"Mechanics only have beauty left. They are really useless when fighting. We Pugilists have the highest win rate in PK. What do you think?"

"You Pugilists only know how to punch and kick. You don't have any skills at all. What's the point of playing? You don't understand the fun of Mechanics at all. How exciting it is to gamble on blueprints, how satisfying it is to collect materials and finally build a machine. How interesting it is to use battle tactics."

"Then the machine that you worked so hard to build will be smashed by us with just a few punches. Ahahahahaha."

"If you can, go find Mad Blade, Angry Sword. Do you think he is the number one Mechanical Pugilist in China? Also, have you seen the competition video of the number one Mechanical Pugilist in North America? How many Pugilists did he beat with his dazzling mechanical combo?"

"Well said, I choose Esper."

"Mechanics are really too expensive. I don't have any money. I only have one life. I can't afford it. I can't afford it."

"Heh, all of you are trash. My magic will tear you into pieces."

Other than these comments, there were also normal discussions.

"Black Phantom is stronger than before. Has he always been this strong, or is he slowly becoming stronger?"

"The Blue Star players are laughing but not saying anything."

"Didn't the Times say that this type of NPC is a protagonist type character? I think that since Black Phantom said that a disaster is about to befall Blue Star and that they should go to the galaxy to find a solution, he will definitely play a role in the next version of the Blue Star storyline. Think about it, the galaxy is the stage of the future. There will definitely be some events that will help us transition from the novice planet to the galaxy. I bet fifty cents that it will definitely be related to him."

"Waiting for the Analysis Emperor to be slapped in the face."

"Tsk tsk, Floating Dragon is really honest."

Other than the discussions, there were also bullet comments.

"I don't know when, but I developed my senses. First, it was a small piece of metal, then more parts. My world was dark. Although I couldn't see, I could feel that someone was creating my body.

I don't know how much time passed, but my senses grew more and more. One day, I suddenly felt pain. The pain made my consciousness gradually clear. Finally, I gained eyes. I tried to open them, and dense streams of data flowed in my vision.

What are these? I am very curious.

A ray of warm light shone down, and the colors of the world spread in front of my eyes. I looked down and saw a mechanical spider.

Is this my body? I thought to myself.

At this time, I heard someone talking above me.

I finally succeeded. His tone was filled with joy.

I looked up and followed the voice. A man was looking down at me. His eyes were filled with love, and there was a smile on his face.

I had never seen such a smile before. It turned out to be so clear and gentle.

He is my creator.

A sense of familiarity rose from the bottom of my heart. But why do I have a heart and feelings? I am just a machine.

Did you give me these, creator?

The man reached out his hand and touched my body. His warmth seeped into my cold armor.

So, this is what warmth feels like.

So comfortable.

I couldn't help but rub his hand. He smiled and said, "Looks like the VR sensor is very successful. The artificial nerves are working normally. Hmm, enter standby mode first."

Suddenly, my body straightened automatically and stopped moving. At this moment, I understood. Although I had senses, I could feel temperature, I could feel pain, but what really controlled me was the AI program.

I was just a machine, not even a life. The meaning of my existence was to follow the program's orders.

But your efforts gave me senses, allowing me to feel this world and experience the senses of life.

This is very fair, isn't it?

It's okay, I am willing to be trapped in this body and watch you silently.

Thank you for creating me. "

"What the f * ck, a great god has appeared."

"Showing off your operation without saying anything. Referee, can you go back and sit down?"

"Great Writer, do you want oranges?"

Han Xiao watched with great interest. The players' imagination was really rich.

Other than these normal comments, the rest were the daily comments of the fans of the top players.

"Li Ge's fan club is the great handsome face."

"I am not convinced, let's fight!"

"My family's Old Wang, Wang Hou Jiang Xiangxiang, is smiling as he looks at the second-tier players."

"Black Phantom's engineering team is here to work. Unrelated people please stand back."

What he did not expect was that there were players using his name to flood the screen. His eyes lit up. Being mocked by others was one of the ways to become famous. He did not expect that he would have fans too.

The video was still going on, and the comments were all over the screen. However, when Ames appeared, all the different comments disappeared and turned into a frenzy of boot-licking comments.

Ames appeared at the dock and sat on the dragon bone throne. She was wearing a high cut black dress, and her long, white legs were like white snakes entwining with each other, revealing a large part of her snow-white skin. She had a beautiful face and was full of charm. Her whole body exuded a mysterious aura. Coupled with her powerful strength, it condensed into multiple temptations, and the audience could not resist.

"What the f * ck, such a beauty."

"Get out of my way, I'll lick you."

"Dragon Emperor Ames, one of the four Beyond Grade A Supers in the Shattered Star Ring. Oh my, she is too sexy."

"Quick, give me a tissue. Don't think too much, I'll use it to wipe my nose."

"So — so domineering, so aggressive. I'm a girl, and I'm being flirted with."

"Quick, take a screenshot, I want to use it as my wallpaper."

"What a pity, she's flat chested."

"What do you know? Why would such a domineering beauty need a chest?"

"Let me introduce her to everyone. This is my new wife."

"I hereby announce that the Ames Guards Army is established on the spot."

Ames' appearance did not last long, and it was soon followed by the subsequent events. In the end, the video ended with the scene of the professional players catching the thief in the Dragon Guards. After that, there were some interactions between the professional players as highlights. However, ever since Ames appeared, the comments were stuck on her and could not come out.

"Her appearance is too short. I want to continue watching the long-legged sisters."

"Who the f * ck wants to watch this group of professional players? Get lost!"

"I've betrayed the sect. Give me back my Ames."

After turning off the video, Han Xiao did not know whether to laugh or cry. Beauties were always popular. After all, most of the people who played games were burly men, and girls were rare. Ames appeared out of nowhere, and her popularity soared immediately, almost surpassing the popularity that he had built up for so long.

She was strong, sexy, and had a very high status. She was very attractive, and her innate qualities were much better than Han Xiao's. What could he do? He was also very helpless.

If a male character wanted to be popular, they had to have some special qualities. They had to be a weirdo, a real man, or extremely strong. He was confident that he did not lack good looks, but the added value of the other factors was not high enough yet.

"However, the more popular Ames is among the players, the better it is for me. I'm temporarily under the Dragon Emperor. If the players know about this, they will be able to share her popularity and increase the attractiveness of my faction."

This was just icing on the cake for Han Xiao. According to his original blueprint, even without Ames' influence, he would be able to make a large number of Blue Star players join him willingly. However, the more influence she had, the better. Of course, he had no problem with that.

"In another two days, the materials I ordered will arrive. There are a lot of machines to be built this time, so I'll probably have to shut myself off for a while. It's best to find something for those professional players to do first. Don't let them be bored, or they will cause trouble."

Pork Bun had been very frustrated recently.

Although the third episode caused a new round of popularity because of Ames' appearance, and this series made his reputation skyrocket, establishing his position in the game and forming a large group of die-hard fans, it also gave Pork Bun trouble at the same time.

The Dragon Emperor was too popular. Many viewers sent him private messages asking him to edit more scenes of Ames. Of course, Pork Bun was willing. He had already thought about the content of the fourth episode, which would form a link with the third episode. Things took a turn for the worse. In the end, he saved the Silvers, added a few new members, and was chased by Dark-star. The Dragon Emperor came to his rescue and caused a sensation.

However, the problem was that he lacked the material for this video.

When he was chased by the Dark-star fleet, he was either on the spaceship or underground. He did not have the chance to record anything at all. He even missed the scene where Ames destroyed the Dark-star fleet, which made him regret.

Such a grand scene, full of explosive material, and he did not record it. What a dereliction of duty!

Therefore, he had been troubled recently. He racked his brains but could not think of how to fill in the missing content.

At this time, Han Xiao entered the resting hall of the stronghold and looked around. Most of the players were here. Seeing him walk in, pairs of eyes gathered on him, flashing with anticipation.
